about_the_game:
This is the demo for Orion's End, a sandbox open world space adventure game. Explore, fight, make friends. The demo is limited to the landing zone of the starter planet and that one star system to explore. There's still quite a lot you can do despite the limitations.

  • Mine on planet and in space

  • Combat pirates in space

  • Explore the system for anomalies

  • Befriend local residents

  • Buy and sell commodities, items and upgrades

This is just a taster for what will be in the full game.
